description: Bug investigation from scenario-qa bug-inbox/data-shape-mismatch/gct-prompt-manager-tests-missing. Repro: `git-control-tower review run prompt-manager --json` produced `checks.tests = failed` for job 07c2f59d-4126-4130-8e49-328ef157a09b, but `summary.dimensions` omitted `tests`, leaving downstream readiness agents without failure evidence. Root cause: `executeReviewRun` records per-check outcomes in `ReviewJobStatus.Checks`, but after checks finish it calls `buildReviewSummary`, which rebuilds dimensions from current downstream service availability and latest listable executions. `fetchTestsDimension` returns nil when test-genie is unavailable and otherwise depends on `ListExecutions`; it does not consume the failed check status or the ExecuteSuite error. Because `ReviewDimensions.Tests` has `json:"tests,omitempty"`, a nil tests dimension disappears from JSON even though the tests check failed. Fix target: when a requested check fails, the completed review summary should include an actionable tests dimension or equivalent structured failure detail, and `dimensionStatuses.tests` should not be `skipped` for a failed requested tests check. Add a regression test covering a failed tests check with no listable test-genie execution or unavailable summary-time test-genie. Key files: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/review_handler.go, review_handler_dimensions.go, review_model.go, review_readiness.go, and existing review handler/store tests.
name: gct-review-summary-tests-missing-on-failed-check
title: Keep failed GCT test checks actionable in review summaries
